notes: Cash basis (modified cash), school district, governmental funds only. Top-level lines from Exhibit D Total Governmental Funds column (p5, after the Reclassifications column removed 97,739.23 of transfers); beginning/ending cash = total fund balances (p5) = Statement of Net Position total (p1). Taxes: Other 2,413,381.26 split using the General (p8-9), Bond (p16) and Special Building (p17) schedules; 2,581.94 of the General Fund's 'Other' taxes on p6 is not on the p8 schedule and is kept as other taxes with review. Non-revenue receipts split into sale of property (p9) and insurance adjustments (p17). Debt Service split into bond principal and interest+fees (p16). Detail: General Fund budgetary schedule (p8-10) used for revenue; for expenditures the object-level Exhibit N (p18-25; the v7 re-trim added report pp39-44, so it is now complete through its Transfers section and Total Cash Disbursements 7,389,926.66 on p25) replaces every program line of the budget schedule, so nothing is double counted; only the budget schedule's Title II zero line, the 8000 Transfers line and the Depreciation transfer contra/other-financing pair stay under the budget schedule, whose total (p10) counts the Exhibit N lines via includes_schedules. Combining schedule (p6-7) duplicates the General Fund and was not recorded. Hidden transfers: the General Fund transportation lines include a 200,000 transfer to the Depreciation Fund (p6-7), which Exhibit N shows as Vehicle Operation Capital Assets 200,000.00 (p23); recorded as printed plus a negative contra expenditure and an other financing line. Activity account receipts include the 70,467.23 General Fund transfer to the Activity fund printed on Exhibit N (p25; with 27,272.00 to School Nutrition, total 97,739.23), recorded as a contra revenue line plus an other financing line. Activities (p14) and Nutrition (p15) schedules together differ from Exhibit C other-governmental totals by 359.00 on both receipts and disbursements (unexplained). Activities Fund per-account schedule used (no per-account budget). Read pages 1-25 of 25.
